bio.headline: Hi, I’m Rezi!
bio.description: I'm a digital marketing project manager and content strategist from Jakarta. For 5+ years, I've turned messy briefs into campaigns that actually ship, from strategy and content planning to performance analysis. I enjoy bridging the gap between what brands want to say and what audiences need to hear.

items: Integrated social media campaigns, from brief to launch to wrap-up
Editorial calendars, timelines, and workflow planning
Reporting and analysis with GA, Meta Business Suite, and Search Console
SEO and competitor research with Ahrefs
